notes: Repo-wide FALLBACK for services without their own file in this tree: max_parallel cap 1, no fixed schedule (on-demand / ad-hoc runs register ad-hoc by module path), stale_process_check on (the stream watchdog restarts a service whose heartbeat code_fingerprint no longer matches the on-disk sources). Not a real service - lookups substitute the requesting service's name. The fallback is a NON-resident task (is_resident false). PRIORITY carries no value here on purpose: a service without its own file derives it from its own name + is_resident/freq (the orchestration give-way rank, _common/service_heartbeat.py derive_priority): resident 80 (is_resident services always live - no freq) > daily 70 > weekly 60 > monthly 50 > quarterly 40 > semiannually 30 > once 20 > occasionally 10 > on_demand 0, plus 100 for the downloads.* domain (downloads outrank every non-download regardless of cadence; higher = wins conflicts). Each service file's explicit priority is a hand override - re-derive it when changing a file's freq or is_resident.
